name: Meep The Foundation
summary:
Meep

I don’t really know how to explain it.
It starts out normal — just some friends messing around, climbing stuff, playing tag like in Gorilla Tag. But then it… changes.

The maps feel wrong. The sounds don’t match what you see. Sometimes you hear breathing, even when no one's near you.
We thought it was a bug until one of us went missing.

If you play long enough, things start showing up.
Stuff moves on its own.
Voices echo weird.
Sometimes you spawn in alone even when you're not supposed to.

We tried
